description:
Fixes for Sync for Reddit v23.06.30-13:39 (free) after Reddit blocked /api/info and /api/morechildren in October 2026.

- **Fix Reddit galleries**: galleries open again.
- **Fix load more comments**: "View more" works again.

v1.0.2 fixes a gallery crash (NoSuchMethodError) when another Sync fix bundle was also used: it now uses its own internal names. If you had that crash, patch the original Sync APK, not the installed app.
